portal.name: myAadhaar
portal.task: Reach the Login button on the myAadhaar home page
portal.notes: During discovery this address sometimes redirected to a beta site (myaadhaarbeta.uidai.gov.in) that was dimmed by an overlay on load. The audit checks whichever version the address serves; the page actually checked is listed below. The login form opens only after Login is pressed, which is out of scope.
